requirement_text.REQ-277: Second of three sibling page-migration requirements implementing docs/migration/decisions/0020-frontend-architecture.md D2b. This requirement covers web/src/pages/definitions/ and web/src/pages/dlq/. Replace hand-rolled tables/buttons/badges/layout wrappers/toasts with DataTable/Button/StatusBadge/PaginationControls primitives, and replace every colour literal with the matching var(--token-name) from web/src/styles/tokens.css. Both directories render JSON payloads -- disposition per-file to JsonDiffView, JsonEditor, or a named hand-rolled exception. DO NOT touch web/tests/guards/forbidlist.ts. This requirement is independent of REQ-276 and REQ-278.

result.summary:
PASS. Read git diff main...HEAD directly (18 files; app-code changes confined to the 4 owned page files + tokens.css + design-system.md + one new test file, matching owned_modules exactly). Verdict against reviewer.md's four questions: (1) Idiomatic vs. crutch -- N/A in the gen_statem/OTP sense (pure frontend React/TSX, no backend state machine involved); judged instead on this requirement's own idiom (design-system primitives vs. hand-rolled markup) -- IDIOMATIC: every table/button/status-pill construct that has a matching primitive was migrated to it (DataTable, Button, StatusBadge, PaginationControls, PageLayout, FilterBar), and every construct left hand-rolled (create-definition modal, create-subscription form, discard-confirm dialog, one-time-secret panel, key/value detail table) has an explicit, non-generic justification tied to a real prop-shape gap (ConfirmDialog's single-string body, DataTable's fixed column model, no per-row style hook) rather than laziness -- no crutch found. (2) Supervision integrity -- N/A, no lib/ or process code touched. (3) Type-safety gaps -- none introduced; the one genuinely new logic path (DlqPage's cursor-stack-to-1-indexed-page synthesis for PaginationControls) is plain arithmetic over existing types, not a new state/enum surface, and is covered by a new regression test (web/src/pages/dlq/__tests__/DlqPage.pagination.test.tsx) rather than left untested -- nothing rising to a docs/issues/ type-safety filing. (4) Scope creep -- NONE: git diff --stat confirms zero edits to web/src/components/ui/ (StatusBadge.tsx, DataTable.tsx, ConfirmDialog.tsx, PageLayout.tsx all untouched) despite two documented prop-shape gaps (StatusBadge's missing webhook domain/empty dlq status table; ConfirmDialog's single-string body) that a lazier pass might have 'fixed in place' -- both were correctly left alone and deferred, matching the design doc's own OQ-1/OQ-2 resolution. Exactly one new token (--shadow-modal-compact) was added, justified by an exact-value gap audit (§6 of the design doc), consistent with decision 0020-frontend-architecture.md D1a's 'one canonical value' precedent -- not framework-ahead-of-need. docs/anti-patterns.md has no entries applicable to this diff (checked for React/primitive/token-migration entries; none exist).

Independent spot-checks (exceeding the 2-of-4 minimum -- all 4 files read in full via git diff, not summarized): DefinitionListPage.tsx -- confirmed STATUS_BADGE hex map deleted, table->DataTable, 6 grepped buttons all migrated (4 to primitive-page Button, 2 inside the still-hand-rolled create modal also to Button), create/import error banners correctly NOT migrated to useToast() (OQ-2's resolution), zero literal colors remain. DlqPage.tsx -- confirmed STATUS_COLOR hex map deleted, main table + retry-history table -> DataTable, both JSON dumps (Context JSON, Source payload) -> JsonEditor(readOnly) matching the design's disposition table exactly (no JsonDiffView misuse -- correctly reasoned as single-object dumps, not before/after comparisons), PaginationControls wrapper implements the exact page/hasNextPage/onPageChange synthesis specified in the design's §5.3, discard-confirm dialog correctly left hand-rolled (tokenized) with its conditional amber warning paragraph intact -- not flattened into ConfirmDialog's single-string body. WebhooksPage.tsx and DefinitionEditorPage.tsx also read in full (not just spot-checked) -- see rebase-verification below.

Rebase-composed conflict resolution independently verified in actual file content, not taken on the step-00b handoff's claim: DefinitionEditorPage.tsx -- diffed main...HEAD directly and cross-checked against `git show main:...DefinitionEditorPage.tsx`. Confirmed ISS-0559's 3 toolbar buttons (Show/Hide Raw JSON `data-testid="btn-show-raw-json"` with `pressed={showRawJson}`, Re-layout `data-testid="btn-auto-layout"` with `title=`, Save `data-testid="btn-save-definition"` with `title=`) are UNCHANGED by this branch's diff -- they were already `Button` components with title/pressed props on main (ISS-0559 landed independently), and REQ-277's diff does not touch those lines at all, meaning the rebase correctly left ISS-0559's work alone rather than reverting or duplicating it. Separately, REQ-277's own migration correctly converted the 2 buttons ISS-0559 had NOT touched (Export, Promote-to-Production -- confirmed raw `<button style={toolbarButtonStyle(...)}>` on main, `<Button variant="secondary">` on HEAD) plus the unsaved-changes dialog's Stay/Discard buttons, and only deleted the `toolbarButtonStyle()` helper after confirming (via grep) zero remaining call sites -- correct, non-lossy composition, neither side silently dropped. DlqPage.tsx and WebhooksPage.tsx -- confirmed `formatDateTime` (react-intl, REQ-285) is imported and used for all date-formatting call sites in both files (DlqPage's `toShortDate` wraps it; WebhooksPage's `created_at` column accessor calls it directly); grepped both files for raw `.toLocaleDateString()`/`.toLocaleString()` -- zero hits, confirming REQ-285's conversion survived the rebase intact and was not reverted by REQ-277's primitive migration.

Colour-literal guard: re-ran the guard's own regex directly (`grep -rEn '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|(rgba?\([^)]+\))|(hsla?\([^)]+\))' web/src/pages/definitions web/src/pages/dlq --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts'`) -- zero matches, independently confirming step-00b's claim rather than trusting it. forbidlist.ts: `git diff main...HEAD -- web/tests/guards/forbidlist.ts` produced zero output (0 lines) -- confirmed byte-identical to main, independently verified.

JSON-display disposition: all 3 JSON displays in scope (DefinitionEditorPage's raw-graph-JSON drawer, DlqPage's Context JSON and Source payload) dispositioned to `JsonEditor(readOnly=true, onChange={() => {}})`, matching the design doc's §4 table exactly -- each is a single-object read-only dump, correctly NOT forced into JsonDiffView (which needs a before/after pair and would misrender a single object as 100% changed). No fourth hand-rolled JSON renderer found anywhere in the 4 files (independently grepped for `<pre>`/`toPrettyJson` residue -- none remain outside the two JsonEditor call sites in DlqPage and one in DefinitionEditorPage).

issues.description: The design doc (lib/letflow/design/req277-page-migration-definitions-dlq.md, OQ-1 and OQ-2) explicitly defers two follow-up items to ORCH under core-directives.md's 'No Issue Left Local-Only' rule: (1) extend StatusBadge.tsx with a real webhook domain and populate the dlq domain's status table (currently both DlqPage and WebhooksPage fall back to a neutral gray badge for every status), (2) mount <ToastContainer/> once in AppShell.tsx so a future requirement can migrate the 8 inline banner/error elements this migration deliberately left hand-rolled to real toasts. Flagging so ORCH files both before this gap is forgotten, not as a blocker on this gate.
